result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards all render correctly. The horizontally scrollable chip row and carousel clipping at the right edge,以及 the card cut off at the bottom, are expected behaviors and not counted. One visual defect stands out: the bottom navigation bar's icons overlap with the system home indicator bar, making the search and bookmark icons appear struck through / broken.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar, the dark horizontal home-indicator / gesture bar is drawn on top of the navigation icons (it crosses through the search magnifier icon and the bookmark/orders icon), making those icons look crossed out or visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding (respect inset_bottom / safe area) so the tab bar icons sit above the home indicator, or move the home indicator zone below the icon row with sufficient spacing.

issues.description: The home indicator bar is dark gray on a light tab bar background and overlaps interactive icons, which also reduces tap-target clarity for the search and orders tabs.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the tab bar background extends behind the home indicator area and icons are offset upward, keeping icon tap targets unobstructed.
